'''Ovarik Tann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for [[Galactic Solutions Industries]], serving as their representative in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Dorn Base]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ovarik Tann appears in the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a GSI Vendor for Imperial players on Hoth.<ref name="TOR" />
